title: E-Waste Collection at JES College
summary: RCMSEP with Rotaract Club of JES Parivartan, continued its E-Waste Collection Drive at JES College in association with My Green Society Foundation, promoting responsible disposal and recycling of electronic waste.
description: RCMSEP with Rotaract Club of JES Parivartan, continued its E-Waste Collection Drive at JES College in association with My Green Society Foundation, promoting responsible disposal and recycling of electronic waste. The initiative encouraged students to dispose of unwanted electronic items through appropriate channels rather than sending them to landfills. Proper e-waste management helps reduce environmental pollution, minimise landfill waste, and ensure that recyclable materials are recovered and reused responsibly. Through this community-led initiative, RCMSEP continues to create awareness about sustainable waste management and encourages citizens to adopt environmentally responsible practices. The drive was a meaningful step towards building a cleaner, greener and more sustainable community.
location: JES College, Jogeshwari East, Mumbai, Maharashtra
